cards.title: Values and Null Safety
cards.code:
val name: String = "Luis"
var nickname: String? = null
val length = nickname?.length ?: 0
cards.description: Prefer immutable val and explicit nullable types.

cards.title: Data Class
cards.code:
data class User(val id: Long, val name: String)

val updated = user.copy(name = "Ana")
cards.description: Data classes provide equality, copy, and destructuring.

cards.title: Sealed Result
cards.description: Sealed types make state handling exhaustive.
